main: Built Trader Memes as a responsive one-page gallery for 75 curated meme images.
Consolidated the catalog into one typed registry with trader-focused titles, consistent searchable tags, and corrected image metadata.
Added live search, quick tag filters, empty results, accessible announcements, and copy-image behavior with a download fallback.
Streamlined the site around a compact sticky header, always-visible tags, immediate interactions, a minimal footer, and matching browser and home-screen icons.
Established repository validation with full-source test coverage, a required Chromium user journey, project-record checks, and removal of unused code and configuration.
Matched direct unit-test file names to the source files they cover.

Made image copying retain browser permission while images load, acknowledge successful copies with a fixed-width ticker animation, and present failures in a red-bordered toast at the top center of the page.
Removed the sticky header separator and fixed the browser favicon by placing it in the directory served by Vite.
Increased the spacing between masonry-grid meme cards across desktop and mobile layouts.
Switched the mobile gallery to one card per row at an earlier 800-pixel breakpoint.
Composed shared meme tag groups in the registry while keeping meme-specific tags inline.
Copy places the absolute meme image URL on the clipboard so Discord paste gets a shareable link.
Split image copy into separate link and PNG data strategy modules, with main wiring only the link path for now.
